verdict.rationale: PayPal documents concrete, named integration paths for buyers to check out inside ChatGPT (ACP via Braintree/Instant Checkout), Google AI Mode/Gemini (UCP via Google Pay/Braintree), plus a broader Store Sync catalog path for conversational discovery and purchase — this is real evidence of in-chat purchase completion, not just discovery. However, coverage is narrower than the story implies: no Claude or Copilot support is evidenced, access is gated behind Braintree accounts, Google merchant registration, or a manual PayPal approval form (not self-serve), and Store Sync is limited to US-only physical goods in USD. missing for 10: Claude/Copilot support, self-serve enablement without gatekeeping/forms, broader (non-US, digital/subscription) coverage, independent/hands-on confirmation of live in-chat purchases.
